criteria.criterion: The glossary has an entry for 'home' (firstmate home) that makes the secondmate and backlog item definitions understandable.
criteria.evidence: New glossary entry in intro.json: 'A firstmate home is one firstmate's own backlog together with the tasks dispatched from it. A secondmate is a persistent home of its own; a backlog item is one unit of work inside a home.' It cites c1, c2, c43. The 'what' paragraph also defines home.

I could not grep the rendered HTML because it is written outside the working directory.

findings.summary: The cards still use 'agent' for both firstmate's deciding part and the workers, so the core ambiguity remains for a newcomer.
findings.evidence: The trigger text is printed as-is: 'the agent runs the spawn script for an item it judged ready (decided by judgment)'. In t8 the failure text reads 'reports that no agent is running' and the changes text reads 'the running agent is replaced', where agent means the worker. model.json was on the list of files to change but was not modified. Only the evaluated_by label is relabelled. This fixes the one sentence the rating quoted, not the root cause.

findings.summary: The tests do not check that card text is free of 'agent'.
findings.evidence: The tests assert only !contains("decided by agent") and !contains("<dt>agent</dt>"), so the remaining 'the agent runs…' trigger text passes unnoticed.

findings.summary: Some rendered text outside the cards still says 'agent' in its older sense.
findings.evidence: The ra2 trade-off says 'the agent must dispatch it again', and the findings detail says 'name the agent as a stand-in'. Both are printed on the page (site.rs lines 428 and 469) and were not changed. Claim texts also say 'agent', but changing claims is out of scope.

findings.summary: The new t10 sentence about t4 cites only the t10 claims (c26–c29).
findings.evidence: The statement that teardown returns the worktree and closes the item at t4 is supported by c12 and c13, which the t10 summary does not cite.

summary: The change fixes most of the newcomer's findings. 'Captain' and 'yolo' are now defined where they first appear, the glossary has a 'home' entry, the six design-choice cards have topic titles, the reopened state carries a note saying the item stays open, the t10 card explains why it is drawn Ready → Ready, and the study id is gone from the lede. The opening paragraphs and Next steps are unchanged. fmt, clippy and all tests pass when I ran them. It fails on one finding: the word 'agent' still means two things on the cards. The renderer changes only the '(decided by …)' label to 'judgment'. Each card's trigger and failure text is still printed straight from model.json. So t1, t4, t9 and t11 say 'the agent runs the … script', meaning firstmate's deciding part. Meanwhile t8 says 'the running agent is replaced' and 'no agent is running', meaning a worker. model.json was on the list of files this change could edit, but it was not touched, and the new tests do not check card text for 'agent'.
